messages:
Amy (CSE): Quick sync — GammaPay renewal next week. They pushed back on our SLA wording: want 99.95% uptime and p95 latency 250ms for generate. We currently promise 99.9% / p95 300ms. Need to surface tradeoffs and any credit exposure. Who can pull last 6w uptime + controller latency by EOD?

Jamal (CSM): I asked them to avoid a hard deadline but they want a formal statement. I have the renewal call Thur 10am PT. I'll own customer comms.

Nina (Solutions Eng): I can grab p95/p99 from per-route dashboards and export charts. Early signal: tail spikes around daily batch windows. Will check model-specific tails and correlation with background jobs.

Oliver (SRE): FYI: planned node-pool upgrades for gamma-region tonight — Canary first. Risk window 22:00-02:00 UTC. Fallback routing to eu-west will be enabled; if we hit rollback we may see ~0.6% availability dip on the affected pool.

infra-bot: Deploy started for pool-gamma-1 at 1779003500.

Amy (CSE): If worst-case = 0.6% dip they could trigger SLA credits. Jamal — can we propose a goodwill alternative to contractual credit? Need proposal and eng signoff before Thurs.

Jamal (CSM): Proposal: 1 month discounted committed capacity (credit in kind, not direct $) + offer path to Dedicated for production grade SLOs. Will draft language. Need engineering to confirm feasibility of burst pool.

Nina (Solutions Eng): For the reporting packet I'll include: 30d uptime %, per-route 95/99 latencies for generate and embedding, and a short RCA template. Queries I'll run (Prometheus):
```
# 30d error rate and p95 latency by route
sum(rate(redwood_request_errors_total[30d]))/sum(rate(redwood_requests_total[30d]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket[30d])) by (le,route))
```
I'll attach raw CSV + PNG of charts.

Oliver (SRE): I can pause non-critical upgrades for GammaPay's region until after the renewal meeting. Also can pre-warm a dedicated burst pool for them for ~30 days if sales approves cost.

Amy (CSE): Action list:
- Nina: export metrics + attach charts (by Wed EOD)
- Oliver: confirm pause + feasibility of burst pool (by Wed EOD)
- Jamal: draft credit language and customer-facing note (by Wed EOD)
- Amy: prepare 3-slide summary for renewal meeting (Thu 10am PT)
Anyone add items? :eyes:

Oliver (SRE): Add: we need exact contract mapping — which routes/regions are in the SLO. If GammaPay uses cross-region routing, that changes numbers.

Nina (Solutions Eng): I'll map their active routes and flag heavy ops (reranking / long-context) that skew latency.

Jamal (CSM): I'll upload the draft credit language to the renewal folder and ping legal for review.

Amy (CSE): Great — thanks all. I'll close thread when slides + metrics uploaded.

Jamal (CSM): Uploaded draft to /shared/gammapay/renewal/credit-draft.md. Will iterate with legal Wed morning.
